description: Pre-built mod_spatialite native libraries for SQLite spatial extensions. Supports Windows (x64, x86), macOS (x64, arm64), and Linux (x64, arm64). Libraries are automatically copied to runtimes/{rid}/spatialite-native/ in the output directory during build. Native assets are registered outside NuGet's runtimes/ asset pipeline, so they never conflict with same-named files (e.g. libfreexl) shipped by other packages.
title: SpatiaLite Native Libraries
